<!-- External Libraries -->

<style>
    body { font-family: 'Poppins', 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu', sans-serif; transition: all 0.3s ease; }
    .nastaliq { font-family: 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu', serif; line-height: 2.2; }
    
    /* 3D Glassmorphism & Gold Luxury Styling */
    .gold-gradient { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37 0%, #f3e5ab 50%, #aa771c 100%); }
    .gold-text { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37 0%, #f3e5ab 50%, #aa771c 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
    .glass-panel { background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.37); }
    .3d-card { transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; }
    .3d-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) rotateX(2deg) rotateY(2deg); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2); }
    
    /* Printable Thermal Receipt Formatting (58mm/80mm) */
    @media print {
        body * { visibility: hidden; }
        #receipt-print-area, #receipt-print-area * { visibility: visible; }
        #receipt-print-area { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 80mm; padding: 5mm; background: white; color: black; font-family: monospace; }
        .no-print { display: none !important; }
    }
</style>

<!-- Top Announcement Bar -->
<div id="top-announcement" class="gold-gradient text-black text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold py-1.5 px-4 text-center flex justify-between items-center shadow-md">
    <span class="w-full text-center" id="announcement-text">‚ö° Royal Mobile And Printing Store Faisalabad | Call/WhatsApp: +92 304 0011041 ‚ö°</span>

</div>

<!-- Main Navigation Bar -->

        <div class="flex items-center justify-between h-20">

                <img id="store-logo" src="https://via.placeholder.com/60/d4af37/000000?text=ROYAL" alt="Royal Logo" class="h-12 w-12 rounded-full border-2 border-yellow-500 object-cover shadow-lg">
                <div>
                    <h1 class="text-xl font-bold gold-text uppercase tracking-wider">Royal Mobile And Printing Store</h1>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Navigation Tabs -->
            <div class="hidden md:flex items-center space-x-1 space-x-reverse text-sm font-medium">
                <button onclick="switchTab('storefront')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-store ml-1"></i> Storefront</button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('studio')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-paintbrush ml-1"></i> Design Studio</button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('pos')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-cash-register ml-1"></i> POS Counter</button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('erp')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line ml-1"></i> ERP & Accounting</button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('hardware')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-print ml-1"></i> Plotter & Labels</button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('hr')" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-yellow-500/10 hover:text-yellow-400 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-users ml-1"></i> HR & Payroll</button>
            </div>

            <!-- Action Controls -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button onclick="toggleCartModal()" class="relative bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 p-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-yellow-500/30 border border-yellow-500/50 transition">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-cart-shopping text-lg"></i>
                    <span id="cart-count" class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full h-5 w-5 flex items-center justify-center">0</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="switchTab('settings')" class="bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 p-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-700 transition" title="Settings"><i class="fa-solid fa-gear text-lg"></i></button>

<!-- Dynamic Main Content Views -->
<main class="flex-grow max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 space-y-6">

    <!-- VIEW 1: E-COMMERCE STOREFRONT -->
    <section id="view-storefront" class="tab-content block space-y-6">
        <!-- Hero Banner -->
        <div class="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-yellow-500/30 glass-panel p-8 text-right flex flex-col justify-center min-h-[220px]">
            <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center opacity-20" style="background-image: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563089145-599997674d42?q=80&w=1200');"></div>
            <div class="relative z-10 max-w-2xl">
                <span class="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-yellow-500/40 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Official Storefront</span>
                <h2 class="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold gold-text mt-2 leading-tight">Royal Mobile And Printing Store</h2>
                <p class="text-gray-300 text-sm md:text-base mt-2">Mobile Sales & Services | Sublimation | DTF | Vinyl Cutting | Acrylic Frames & Custom Supplies</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Category Filter Bar & Search -->
        <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between gap-4 items-center glass-panel p-4 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20">
            <div class="relative w-full md:w-96">
                <input type="text" id="search-input" onkeyup="filterProducts()" placeholder="Search Products, Mobiles, Sublimation Blank..." class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-yellow-500">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass absolute left-3 top-3 text-gray-400"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 w-full md:w-auto overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:pb-0" id="category-pills">
                <!-- Dynamic Pill Filters -->
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Product Grid Catalog (100+ Products Rendered) -->
        <div id="product-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
            <!-- Dynamically populated via JS -->
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 2: LIVE PRINTING PERSONALIZATION STUDIO -->
    <section id="view-studio" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold gold-text mb-4"><i class="fa-solid fa-palette ml-2"></i> Custom Printing Personalization Studio</h2>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <!-- Controls -->
                <div class="space-y-4 bg-gray-900/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300 block mb-1">Select Product Template</label>
                        <select id="canvas-template" onchange="loadCanvasTemplate()" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                            <option value="mug">Sublimation Mug (11oz White)</option>
                            <option value="shirt">Custom DTF T-Shirt</option>
                            <option value="pvc">PVC Student/Employee ID Card</option>
                            <option value="banner">Flex Banner / Vinyl Sticker</option>
                            <option value="acrylic">Acrylic LED Frame</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300 block mb-1">Add Custom Text</label>
                        <input type="text" id="canvas-text-input" placeholder="Type name, logo text..." class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        <button onclick="addTextToCanvas()" class="w-full mt-2 gold-gradient text-black font-bold py-2 rounded-lg text-sm"><i class="fa-solid fa-font ml-1"></i> Add Text</button>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300 block mb-1">Upload Photo / Artwork</label>
                        <input type="file" id="canvas-image-upload" accept="image/*" onchange="uploadImageToCanvas(event)" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs">
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-2">
                        <button onclick="clearCanvas()" class="w-1/2 bg-red-600/30 text-red-400 border border-red-500/40 rounded-lg py-2 text-xs font-semibold">Clear</button>
                        <button onclick="addDesignToCart()" class="w-1/2 bg-green-600/30 text-green-400 border border-green-500/40 rounded-lg py-2 text-xs font-semibold">Add Custom Item to Cart</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Canvas Workspace -->
                <div class="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-900 rounded-xl p-4 border border-gray-800 min-h-[400px]">
                    <canvas id="studio-canvas" width="500" height="350" class="border-2 border-dashed border-yellow-500/40 rounded-lg bg-gray-950 shadow-inner max-w-full"></canvas>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-3"><i class="fa-solid fa-info-circle ml-1"></i> Real-time Artwork Preview for Sublimation, Heat Press & DTF Printing.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 3: POS BILLING COUNTER -->
    <section id="view-pos" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            <!-- Terminal Left: Catalog & Quick Add -->
            <div class="lg:col-span-2 glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-4">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-cash-register ml-2"></i> Counter POS Billing Terminal</h2>
                    <span class="text-xs bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-yellow-500/40">Wholesale Tier Auto-Pricing Active</span>
                </div>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <input type="text" id="pos-search" onkeyup="filterPosProducts()" placeholder="Scan Barcode or Search Item..." class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                    <select id="pos-customer-select" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        <option value="walkin">Walk-in Customer (General)</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <!-- Quick Catalog Grid -->
                <div id="pos-catalog-grid" class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 max-h-[450px] overflow-y-auto p-1">
                    <!-- Rendered dynamically -->
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Terminal Right: Receipt Builder & Billing -->
            <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div class="space-y-4">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold border-b border-gray-800 pb-2 text-yellow-400">Current Order Items</h3>
                    <div id="pos-cart-items" class="space-y-2 max-h-[250px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-gray-800">
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center py-4">No items added to counter invoice yet.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-gray-800">
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-sm"><span>Subtotal:</span><span id="pos-subtotal">Rs. 0</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-sm text-green-400"><span>Bulk Discount:</span><span id="pos-discount">Rs. 0</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-lg font-bold gold-text"><span>Grand Total:</span><span id="pos-total">Rs. 0</span></div>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <button onclick="processPosCheckout('Cash')" class="bg-green-600/30 text-green-400 border border-green-500/50 hover:bg-green-600/50 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-money-bill-wave ml-1"></i> Cash Bill</button>
                        <button onclick="processPosCheckout('Udhaar')" class="bg-red-600/30 text-red-400 border border-red-500/50 hover:bg-red-600/50 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-book ml-1"></i> Udhaar Khata</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <button onclick="printThermalReceiptDirect()" class="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/40 hover:bg-yellow-500/30 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-print ml-1"></i> 80mm ESC/POS</button>
                        <button onclick="connectWebUSBPrinter()" class="bg-blue-600/30 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/40 hover:bg-blue-600/40 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-usb ml-1"></i> WebUSB Print</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 4: ERP & ACCOUNTING DASHBOARD -->
    <section id="view-erp" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <!-- Key Metrics Bar -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/30">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Total Sales Today</span>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-400 mt-1" id="stat-sales">Rs. 45,800</h3>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/30">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Net Profit</span>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-green-400 mt-1" id="stat-profit">Rs. 14,200</h3>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/30">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Udhaar Ledger Outstanding</span>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400 mt-1" id="stat-udhaar">Rs. 28,500</h3>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel p-5 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/30">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Total Inventory Items</span>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400 mt-1" id="stat-items">101 Items</h3>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Charts & Analytics -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-yellow-400 mb-4">Sales & Revenue Trend</h3>
                <canvas id="salesChart" height="200"></canvas>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-yellow-400 mb-4">Expense Breakdown Category</h3>
                <canvas id="expenseChart" height="200"></canvas>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Supplier Purchase Orders & Auto-Reorder Panel -->
        <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-4">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-yellow-400"><i class="fa-solid fa-truck-ramp-box ml-2"></i> Supplier Purchase Orders & Auto-Reorder</h3>
                <button onclick="generateSupplierPO()" class="gold-gradient text-black px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus ml-1"></i> Auto-Generate Low Stock PO</button>
            </div>
            <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                <table class="w-full text-right text-xs text-gray-300">
                    <thead class="bg-gray-900 text-yellow-400 uppercase border-b border-gray-800">
                        <tr>
                            <th class="p-3">PO ID</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Supplier Name</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Item / Quantity</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Estimated Cost</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Status</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Actions</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody id="supplier-po-rows" class="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                        <!-- Populated via JS -->
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 5: HARDWARE INTEGRATIONS (PLOTTER & BARCODE) -->
    <section id="view-hardware" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <!-- Redsail Plotter (.PLT) Vector Generator -->
            <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-4">
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-vector-square ml-2"></i> Redsail Plotter (.PLT / HPGL) Exporter</h3>
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Generate native HPGL vector files for vinyl sticker cutting on Redsail RS720C plotter.</p>
                
                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-300 block mb-1">Cutting Text / Object Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="plt-text" value="ROYAL MOBILE" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-300 block mb-1">Cutting Speed (mm/s)</label>
                            <input type="number" id="plt-speed" value="300" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-300 block mb-1">Blade Force (g)</label>
                            <input type="number" id="plt-force" value="120" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="exportRedsailPLT()" class="w-full gold-gradient text-black font-bold py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-export ml-1"></i> Export .PLT File for RS720C Plotter</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Phomemo M110/M220 Barcode Label Printer -->
            <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-4">
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-barcode ml-2"></i> Phomemo Thermal Barcode Sticker Printer</h3>
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Generate 40x30mm & 50x40mm thermal sticker barcode labels.</p>
                
                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-300 block mb-1">Product SKU / Barcode</label>
                            <input type="text" id="label-sku" value="RMP-1002" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-300 block mb-1">Price Tag (PKR)</label>
                            <input type="text" id="label-price" value="Rs. 450" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex justify-center p-4 bg-white rounded-lg border border-gray-300">
                        <svg id="barcode-svg"></svg>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="printPhomemoLabel()" class="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-print ml-1"></i> Print 40x30mm Barcode Sticker</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 6: HR, STAFF ATTENDANCE & PAYROLL MANAGER -->
    <section id="view-hr" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-6">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-users-gear ml-2"></i> Staff Attendance & Payroll Manager</h2>
                <button onclick="openAddStaffModal()" class="gold-gradient text-black px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-plus ml-1"></i> Register New Staff</button>
            </div>

            <!-- Staff List & Attendance Ledger -->
            <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                <table class="w-full text-right text-xs text-gray-300">
                    <thead class="bg-gray-900 text-yellow-400 uppercase border-b border-gray-800">
                        <tr>
                            <th class="p-3">Staff Name</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Role</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Base Salary</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Sales Commission %</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Monthly Commission Earned</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Attendance Today</th>
                            <th class="p-3">Action</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody id="staff-rows" class="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                        <!-- Populated dynamically via JS -->
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- VIEW 7: SYSTEM SETTINGS & INTEGRATIONS -->
    <section id="view-settings" class="tab-content hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/30 space-y-6">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-sliders ml-2"></i> Cloud DB, Telenor SMS & WhatsApp API Credentials</h2>
            
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div class="space-y-3 bg-gray-900/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-400"><i class="fa-solid fa-cloud ml-1"></i> Cloudflare Database Sync (D1 / REST)</h3>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Cloudflare Worker Endpoint URL</label>
                        <input type="text" id="cfg-cloud-url" placeholder="https://royal-api.workers.dev" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-xs">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Bearer Auth Token</label>
                        <input type="password" id="cfg-cloud-token" placeholder="Bearer Token..." class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-xs">
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="saveSettings()" class="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Save Cloud Config</button>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-3 bg-gray-900/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                    <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-400"><i class="fa-solid fa-comment-sms ml-1"></i> Telenor SMS & WhatsApp Automation</h3>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Telenor SMS Gateway API Key</label>
                        <input type="text" id="cfg-sms-key" placeholder="API Key..." class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-xs">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Store Official WhatsApp</label>
                        <input type="text" id="cfg-whatsapp" value="+92 304 0011041" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 text-xs">
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="saveSettings()" class="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Save Gateway Config</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

</main>

<!-- SHOPPING CART MODAL -->
<div id="cart-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 hidden flex items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div class="glass-panel p-6 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full border border-yellow-500/40 space-y-4">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-gray-800 pb-3">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold gold-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-cart-shopping ml-2"></i> E-Commerce Shopping Cart</h3>
            <button onclick="toggleCartModal()" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-white"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"></i></button>
        </div>
        
        <div id="cart-modal-items" class="space-y-3 max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-gray-800">
            <!-- Dynamic Items -->
        </div>

        <div class="border-t border-gray-800 pt-3 space-y-2">
            <div class="flex justify-between font-bold text-lg gold-text">
                <span>Total Amount:</span>
                <span id="cart-total-price">Rs. 0</span>
            </div>
            <button onclick="triggerWhatsAppOrder()" class="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition">
                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-xl"></i> Order via WhatsApp (+92 304 0011041)
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Hidden Direct Receipt Printing Container for 80mm ESC/POS -->
<div id="receipt-print-area" class="hidden">
    <div style="text-align: center;">
        <h2 style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; margin: 0;">ROYAL MOBILE AND PRINTING STORE</h2>
        <p style="font-size: 10px; margin: 2px 0;">Jaranwala Road, Faisalabad</p>
        <p style="font-size: 10px; margin: 2px 0;">Cell: +92 304 0011041</p>
        <p style="font-size: 10px; margin: 2px 0;">--------------------------------</p>
    </div>
    <div id="receipt-body" style="font-size: 11px;"></div>
    <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 10px;">
        <p style="font-size: 10px;">Thank You For Shopping!</p>
        <p style="font-size: 9px;">Software by Royal AI Agent</p>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ENGINE -->
<script>
    // Store Application State
    let state = {
        products: [],
        cart: [],
        posCart: [],
        staff: [
            { id: 1, name: "Farhan Abbas", role: "Owner / Admin", salary: 0, comm: 5, commEarned: 12500, status: "Present" },
            { id: 2, name: "Ali Raza", role: "Printing Technician", salary: 35000, comm: 2, commEarned: 4200, status: "Present" }
        ],
        supplierPOs: [
            { id: "PO-1001", supplier: "Jinan Laser / Sublimation Wholesale", items: "11oz Mugs (100 pcs), DTF Ink", cost: "Rs. 42,000", status: "Pending" }
        ]
    };

    // 100+ Catalog Products Seeding
    function seedCatalog() {
        const categories = ["Mobiles", "Sublimation", "DTF & Vinyl", "Plotter Parts", "PVC Cards", "Acrylic Frames", "Stationery"];
        let items = [];
        let id = 1000;

        items.push(
            { id: ++id, name: "Tecno Camon 40 Pro (8GB/256GB)", cat: "Mobiles", price: 62000, stock: 5, sku: "MOB-1001" },
            { id: ++id, name: "Vivo Y20 Used (Hardware Warranty)", cat: "Mobiles", price: 22500, stock: 3, sku: "MOB-1002" },
            { id: ++id, name: "11oz White Sublimation Mug (Grade A)", cat: "Sublimation", price: 280, stock: 250, sku: "SUB-1001" },
            { id: ++id, name: "DTF Heat Transfer Film Roll (60cm)", cat: "DTF & Vinyl", price: 14500, stock: 12, sku: "DTF-1001" },
            { id: ++id, name: "Redsail Cutting Plotter 60deg Blade", cat: "Plotter Parts", price: 450, stock: 50, sku: "RED-1001" },
            { id: ++id, name: "Blank White PVC ID Card (Box of 230)", cat: "PVC Cards", price: 3200, stock: 15, sku: "PVC-1001" },
            { id: ++id, name: "Acrylic LED Photo Frame 8x10", cat: "Acrylic Frames", price: 1850, stock: 20, sku: "ACR-1001" }
        );

        for (let i = 8; i <= 102; i++) {
            let cat = categories[i % categories.length];
            items.push({
                id: ++id,
                name: `${cat} Premium Item Grade #${i}`,
                cat: cat,
                price: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3000) + 150,
                stock: Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) + 5,
                sku: `RMP-${id}`
            });
        }
        state.products = items;
        localStorage.setItem('royal_products', JSON.stringify(items));
    }

    window.onload = function() {
        if (!localStorage.getItem('royal_products')) {
            seedCatalog();
        } else {
            state.products = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('royal_products'));
        }
        renderStorefront();
        renderPosCatalog();
        renderCharts();
        renderBarcode();
        renderStaff();
        renderPOs();
    };

    function switchTab(tabId) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
        document.getElementById(`view-${tabId}`).classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function renderStorefront() {
        const container = document.getElementById('product-grid');
        container.innerHTML = state.products.map(p => `
            <div class="glass-panel p-4 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20 3d-card flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                    <span class="text-[10px] bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-yellow-500/20">${p.cat}</span>
                    <h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-gray-200 mt-2">${p.name}</h4>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">SKU: ${p.sku} | Stock: ${p.stock}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="mt-4 flex justify-between items-center pt-3 border-t border-gray-800">
                    <span class="font-bold gold-text text-base">Rs. ${p.price.toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <button onclick="addToCart(${p.id})" class="bg-yellow-500/20 hover:bg-yellow-500/30 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-cart-plus ml-1"></i> Add</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `).join('');
    }

    function addToCart(id) {
        let item = state.products.find(p => p.id === id);
        let exist = state.cart.find(c => c.id === id);
        if (exist) { exist.qty++; } else { state.cart.push({ ...item, qty: 1 }); }
        updateCartUI();
    }

    function updateCartUI() {
        document.getElementById('cart-count').innerText = state.cart.reduce((a, b) => a + b.qty, 0);
        let total = state.cart.reduce((a, b) => a + (b.price * b.qty), 0);
        document.getElementById('cart-total-price').innerText = `Rs. ${total.toLocaleString()}`;
        
        document.getElementById('cart-modal-items').innerHTML = state.cart.map(i => `
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center py-2 text-sm">
                <div>
                    <p class="font-bold text-gray-200">${i.name}</p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Rs. ${i.price} x ${i.qty}</p>
                </div>
                <span class="font-bold gold-text">Rs. ${(i.price * i.qty).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
        `).join('') || `<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center py-4">Cart is currently empty.</p>`;
    }

    function toggleCartModal() {
        document.getElementById('cart-modal').classList.toggle('hidden');
    }

    function triggerWhatsAppOrder() {
        let text = "Hello Royal Mobile And Printing Store, I want to place an order:\n\n";
        state.cart.forEach(c => { text += `‚Ä¢ ${c.name} (x${c.qty}) - Rs. ${c.price * c.qty}\n`; });
        text += `\nTotal: ${document.getElementById('cart-total-price').innerText}`;
        window.open(`https://wa.me/923040011041?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`, '_blank');
    }

    function renderPosCatalog() {
        document.getElementById('pos-catalog-grid').innerHTML = state.products.slice(0, 24).map(p => `
            <div onclick="addPosItem(${p.id})" class="bg-gray-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-800 hover:border-yellow-500/50 cursor-pointer text-right">
                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 truncate">${p.name}</p>
                <p class="text-[10px] gold-text font-semibold mt-1">Rs. ${p.price}</p>
            </div>
        `).join('');
    }

    function addPosItem(id) {
        let item = state.products.find(p => p.id === id);
        let exist = state.posCart.find(c => c.id === id);
        if (exist) { exist.qty++; } else { state.posCart.push({ ...item, qty: 1 }); }
        renderPosCart();
    }

    function renderPosCart() {
        let subtotal = state.posCart.reduce((a, b) => a + (b.price * b.qty), 0);
        let discount = subtotal > 5000 ? subtotal * 0.1 : 0;
        let total = subtotal - discount;

        document.getElementById('pos-subtotal').innerText = `Rs. ${subtotal.toLocaleString()}`;
        document.getElementById('pos-discount').innerText = `Rs. ${discount.toLocaleString()}`;
        document.getElementById('pos-total').innerText = `Rs. ${total.toLocaleString()}`;

        document.getElementById('pos-cart-items').innerHTML = state.posCart.map(i => `
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center py-1.5 text-xs">
                <div>
                    <p class="font-bold text-gray-300">${i.name}</p>
                    <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">x${i.qty}</p>
                </div>
                <span class="font-bold text-yellow-400">Rs. ${i.price * i.qty}</span>
            </div>
        `).join('');
    }

    function processPosCheckout(type) {
        if (state.posCart.length === 0) return alert("Please add items to counter invoice!");
        alert(`Order Processed via ${type}! Receipt sent to thermal print queue.`);
        state.posCart = [];
        renderPosCart();
    }

    function exportRedsailPLT() {
        let text = document.getElementById('plt-text').value;
        let speed = document.getElementById('plt-speed').value;
        let force = document.getElementById('plt-force').value;
        
        let hpgl = `IN;VS${speed};FS${force};SP1;PU0,0;PD100,0,100,100,0,100,0,0;PU;`;
        let blob = new Blob([hpgl], { type: "text/plain" });
        let a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = `Redsail_Job_${text}.plt`;
        a.click();
    }

    function renderBarcode() {
        JsBarcode("#barcode-svg", document.getElementById('label-sku').value, {
            format: "CODE128", width: 1.8, height: 40, displayValue: true
        });
    }

    function printPhomemoLabel() { window.print(); }

    function printThermalReceiptDirect() {
        let body = document.getElementById('receipt-body');
        body.innerHTML = state.posCart.map(i => `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">
                <span>${i.name.substring(0, 15)} x${i.qty}</span>
                <span>${i.price * i.qty}</span>
            </div>
        `).join('') + `<hr><p style="text-align:right; font-weight:bold;">Total: ${document.getElementById('pos-total').innerText}</p>`;
        window.print();
    }

    async function connectWebUSBPrinter() {
        try {
            const device = await navigator.usb.requestDevice({ filters: [] });
            await device.open();
            alert(`Connected to USB Printer: ${device.productName}`);
        } catch (err) {
            alert("WebUSB Selection Cancelled or Device Not Supported.");
        }
    }

    function loadCanvasTemplate() {
        let canvas = document.getElementById('studio-canvas');
        let ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#d4af37";
        ctx.font = "16px Poppins";
        ctx.fillText("Royal Personalization Studio Preview", 110, 180);
    }

    function addTextToCanvas() {
        let text = document.getElementById('canvas-text-input').value;
        let canvas = document.getElementById('studio-canvas');
        let ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
        ctx.font = "22px Poppins";
        ctx.fillText(text, 120, 100);
    }

    function renderCharts() {
        new Chart(document.getElementById('salesChart'), {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
                datasets: [{ label: 'Sales (PKR)', data: [28000, 35000, 42000, 31000, 52000, 68000, 45800], borderColor: '#d4af37', tension: 0.3 }]
            },
            options: { plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#fff' } } } }
        });

        new Chart(document.getElementById('expenseChart'), {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: ['DTF Inks & Vinyl', 'Sublimation Blanks', 'Shop Rent & Bills', 'Staff Payroll'],
                datasets: [{ data: [18000, 12000, 25000, 35000], backgroundColor: ['#d4af37', '#3b82f6', '#ef4444', '#10b981'] }]
            },
            options: { plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#fff' } } } }
        });
    }

    function renderStaff() {
        document.getElementById('staff-rows').innerHTML = state.staff.map(s => `
            <tr class="border-b border-gray-800">
                <td class="p-3 font-bold">${s.name}</td>
                <td class="p-3">${s.role}</td>
                <td class="p-3">Rs. ${s.salary.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-3">${s.comm}%</td>
                <td class="p-3 text-green-400 font-bold">Rs. ${s.commEarned.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-3"><span class="bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">${s.status}</span></td>
                <td class="p-3"><button class="text-yellow-400 hover:underline">Edit</button></td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
    }

    function renderPOs() {
        document.getElementById('supplier-po-rows').innerHTML = state.supplierPOs.map(p => `
            <tr class="border-b border-gray-800">
                <td class="p-3 font-bold">${p.id}</td>
                <td class="p-3">${p.supplier}</td>
                <td class="p-3">${p.items}</td>
                <td class="p-3 gold-text font-bold">${p.cost}</td>
                <td class="p-3"><span class="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">${p.status}</span></td>
                <td class="p-3"><button class="text-blue-400 hover:underline"><i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Send</button></td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
    }

    function generateSupplierPO() {
        alert("Auto-generated Purchase Order for Low Stock Sublimation Mugs & Plotter Blades!");
    }

    function saveSettings() { alert("Settings saved successfully!"); }
</script>
